title: A Roadmap for Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) Specification Documents
summary: A roadmap to the RFCs relating to TCP. It summarizes documents defining TCP and its extensions and works as a guide and quick reference for implementers and users. It is informational and has been replaced by RFC 7414.

eli5.summary: This is a map of all the rulebooks about TCP, with a short note on what each does so you can find the right one.
